subject: Post-demo: feature profitability scenarios & pricing workshop
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lee <emma@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: feature profitability scenarios & pricing workshop

Hi Emma — great to meet today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Usage sketch (your estimates)
- Active users (monthly): 80k–120k (pilot target 10k MAU)
- Average queries per user per month: 6–10
- Avg tokens/query (prompt+response): low priority flows 350 tokens, high-context flows 1,200 tokens
=> Range: ~170M to 1.1B tokens/month (we used conservative/worst-case to illustrate upper bound)

2) Budget & targets
- Stated budget range: $8k–$25k / month in Year 1 for inference (you mentioned a cap around $20k if unit economics work)
- You asked for a target price benchmark: ~$800–$1,200 per 1M tokens on gross cost would allow product-level pricing to hit your desired $/feature (see below).

3) Feature-level unit economics (initial framework)
- Core triage feature (low-context): 350 tokens/query, expected margin target 60% at feature price $0.15/user/month
- Care-plan summary (high-context): 1,200 tokens/query, margin target 50% at feature price $0.60/user/month
- We sketched CAC payback goal: <=6 months for self-serve motions, up to 12 months for paid enterprise channels.

4) Questions / asks (so we can model precisely)
- Please confirm realistic MAU split by feature (e.g., % using triage vs summaries).
- Any hard constraints on latency/region model residency that would affect model choice?
- Finance: is the $8k–$25k/month strictly for inference or does it include support/infra?

5) Next steps
- I attached a draft econ worksheet (acme-econ-draft.xlsx) with three scenarios (conservative / base / aggressive). Can you review and drop in your MAU split and realistic token-per-interaction numbers?
- Proposed: 60-minute pricing workshop w/ Finance + Product next Wed 10:00am PT to align on target $/1M tokens and CAC assumptions. I’ll send calendar invite once we confirm attendees.

If that all looks right, I’ll loop in R&D to surface model/quantization profiles that match the mid-case cost target. Thanks again!

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachment: acme-econ-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 tabs: assumptions, scenarios, sensitivity)
Attachment: demo-recording.mp4 (30m)
From: Emma Lee <emma@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: feature profitability scenarios & pricing workshop

Thanks Hannah — helpful recap and appreciate the clear asks. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The $8k–$25k is only for inference costs (we have a separate integration/billing bucket). Finance was clear they want inference OPEX isolated.
- MAU split: initially we expect ~65% triage (low-context), 25% summaries (high-context), 10% other (search/rerank). Pilot MAU will be ~8k with similar distribution.
- Latency: triage needs <400ms p50; summaries can tolerate up to 1.2s p50. We’d prefer regionally hosted in us-west.

We’ll drop accurate token-per-interaction numbers into your sheet by EOD Tue. Wed 10:00am PT works for our Product + Finance. Please CC our Head of Finance (procurement@acmehealth.com) on the invite.

Emma Lee
Head of Product, Acme Health
emma@acmehealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: feature profitability scenarios & pricing workshop

Forwarding Emma’s confirmations — a couple internal notes before the workshop: 

- Cost assumptions we should pre-load into the workbook:
  * Hosted baseline (gpt-like open model): $650 / 1M tokens (current mid-case)
  * Quantized private variant (dedicated): $420 / 1M tokens (with 8-bit optimizations + prefix caching)
  * Fallback bucket (low-capacity, cheaper model): $250 / 1M tokens (higher latency, lower quality)

- For feature-margin modeling, we should include: CAC allocation per new user ($18 for self-serve init), ongoing support/admin per MAU ($0.08/user/month), and commercial uplift (sales/CS amortized).

- Ask to Product/CS: what % of users converting to paid do we expect from the pilot (helps CAC payback math)? If pilot converts at 2–3% that's a worse-case for payback; 8–12% gets us to 6-month payback with mid-case pricing.

I'll prepare two model mixes (hosted-only vs hosted+dedicated) to show sensitivity on margin and payback at the workshop.

— Karthik
Director, Solutions 
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Emma Lee <emma@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: feature profitability scenarios & pricing workshop

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Wed 10:00am PT. Agenda I’ll send in the invite: 

1) Review Acme-provided MAU/token inputs (5–10m)
2) Walk through three econ scenarios (conservative / base / aggressive) with cost mixes and $/1M token sensitivities (25m)
3) CAC payback and per-feature margin outputs, tradeoffs by model mix (15m)
4) Next steps: decision points and timeline for pilot pricing (10m)

Action items (owner / due):
- Emma / Acme Finance: populate MAU split + token-per-interaction into spreadsheet (Tue EOD)
- Karthik: load model-cost rows into tab ‘cost_assumptions’ (Tue EOD)
- Marissa: draft pricing cadence options and recommended target $/1M tokens to present (Tue EOD)
- Hannah: send invite + agenda + link to shared Drive (today)

I’ll also bring a slide showing how different caching/batching settings impact effective $/1M tokens in short bursts — that often moves finance from a surprise to a plan. Looking forward to it.

— Hannah
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
summary: Post-demo sales thread: captured Acme Health token-volume estimates, budget constraints ($8k–$25k/month for inference), MAU splits and latency needs. Internal cost assumptions and requested inputs for an upcoming pricing workshop to align on target $/1M tokens, per-feature margins, and CAC payback timeline. Attachments include draft econ workbook and demo recording.
